mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `login_captcha` (`session_id`, `code`, `expired_time`) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{code}, #{expiredTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `code` = #{code}, `expired_time` = #{expiredTime}
INSERT INTO `login_failed_count` (`user_id`, `failed_count`) VALUES (#{userId}, #{failedCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE failed_count = (failed_count + 1)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_captcha WHERE NOW(3) > expired_time
DELETE FROM `login_audit` WHERE `login_time` < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{value} DAY)
